native_evidence.stock: Original gauge native network UUID, native LogisticallyLinkedBehaviour.getAllPresent cached links, PackagerLink native getPackager, loaded native inventory identity or native isTargetingSameInventory alias, exact product increase from the same native insertion equals source debit
